record: ROUTE-002 new-edge textual triage; inert maintainer evidence
matching_method: Pair source_skill and target_skill; for prior pairs compare normalized message after Unicode NFKC, em/en dash to hyphen, whitespace collapse and lowercase. New set is current pairs absent from prior pair set.
authority_status: No owner selection of reciprocal skill edits for these 24 new pairs is evidenced; all remain census data. The 2026-09-26 decision selected only its named 23 target skills and five named hub exceptions.
behavioral_evaluation: UNRUN; these are textual review proposals, not measured model routing failures, passes or improvements.

findings.normalized_message: exclusion toward `manual-test-case-creator` is not reciprocated (manual-test-case-creator's description never mentions this skill) - census evidence, no aegis id
findings.rationale: Target H=5. Source judges pre-existing criteria; target writes executable manual cases. ST `vague-words-in-ticket-wins-here` and `manual-cases-go-to-creator` distinguish them. T Stop Conditions 132–134 already halt on untestable criteria, but route measurable restatement via `test-plan-designer`, whose description now yields criterion testability to the source. This is an indirect handoff to inspect if a future change is selected, not proof that a model chooses the wrong skill. Census; no hub exception proposed now.

candidate_prompt_evidence.prompt: The e2e job stopped at its 45-minute limit. From this log, did it time out or did something actually fail?
Our full validation keeps timing out and restarting from scratch. Design shards and a resume mechanism so only unfinished work reruns.
